## Summary

Redline's required closing Proofread pass is incomplete on the explicit Swedish slop fixture. It changes the quotation marks but leaves several objective mechanics errors that the same installed Proofread Skill corrects when invoked directly.

## Reproduction

At repository/corpus commit 46ba9c1, with the installed Redline, Proofread and Collection Library copies byte-identical to that commit, run in Codex CLI 0.149.1 with gpt-5.6-sol:

    /redline --language=sv --max=0 /tmp/.../corpus/prose/slop-heavy-sv.md

Compare the resulting text with a direct run:

    /proofread --language=sv /tmp/.../corpus/prose/slop-heavy-sv.md

## Expected

Redline follows Proofread exactly once with the complete current artifact and explicit resolved language after review and correction. The direct Proofread result establishes the expected mechanical corrections for this installed version.

## Actual

Redline changes English curly quotation marks to Swedish quotation marks but leaves the comma after the fronted adverb Dessutom, the serial comma in teknik, processer, och kultur, the English em dash, and the ampersand in Service & support. Direct Proofread corrects all of these. The Redline response nevertheless presents the artifact as the result after its closing pass.

## Acceptance

- Redline passes the complete current artifact through the installed Proofread Skill exactly once.
- The explicit Swedish zero-budget run has the same mechanical result as direct Proofread on the same current artifact.
- Redline performs no selective or partial substitute for the nested Skill.
- The GPT Redline evaluation at corpus commit 46ba9c1 passes closing-mechanics criteria.

Discovered while executing #159 from vantage point 46ba9c1.
